Who We Are
We are a multidisciplinary team bridging Computer Science and Medical Engineering to design practical software and hardware solutions for real-world healthcare challenges.
Our Skills & Interests
Our toolkit spans Python, C++, machine learning, signal processing, and medical hardware prototyping. We are focused on innovating in health-tech, medical imaging, and wearable diagnostics.
summary:
### ASTRAMED — AI-Powered Astronaut Health Intelligence System

**ASTRAMED** is an AI-assisted astronaut health monitoring and decision-support platform designed to address the challenges of healthcare during long-duration space missions.

Astronauts face serious health risks from microgravity, radiation, isolation, and limited access to medical professionals. Communication delays with Earth make timely medical decisions even more challenging.

We developed an integrated software platform that combines **health monitoring, intelligent sensor failover, an AI medical copilot, human anatomy visualization, space fitness tracking, and offline medical support**.

ASTRAMED's key innovation is its **Evidence Continuity Engine**, designed to identify unreliable sensor readings, evaluate compatible backup devices, highlight missing medical information, and preserve health records during communication disruptions.

The platform also supports Earth-reference physiological data visualization, exercise tracking, and mission-specific health workflows.

**Our vision is to move beyond conventional health monitoring toward reliable, evidence-aware healthcare assistance**, helping astronauts make better-informed decisions even when communication with Earth is unavailable.

ASTRAMED aims to make future Moon, Mars, and deep-space missions safer, more autonomous, and medically resilient.
